dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge, forming a smooth falcate profile from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a medium pixel radius at the morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree posterior slope relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc with a large radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick proportional length with minimal extension beyond the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible where the steep melon slope transitions into the horizontal plane of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan/teal monochromatic coloration across the entire subject with high-intensity specular highlights along the mid-dorsal flank.
